standing: Publisher release candidate. UML report generated in 2018; use package release date for release identity. Final 4.0.0 is a separate edition baseline.

artifacts.contact: Text extracted; selected diagrams checked for AssetSegmentEvent, model variant, measurement location. Full semantic comparison pending.

Pinned publisher XML opened and 4,761 typed entities indexed. Named entries were checked against their parent type and relevant core-schema declaration for the individual row claims. Other reference terms, constraints and use at actual sites remain unassessed.

101.standing: Enterprise exchange lineage and relational model, separately editioned

102.standing: Scenario guidance, useful for checking functional location, actual event and serialized asset relationships

source_findings.asset-installation: AssetSegmentEvent extends ActualEvent. Asset and Segment are each structurally optional. The publisher’s Scenario 11 requires the asset, location and event time for that use case. Do not generalize the scenario’s required content to every core-schema instance.
source_findings.measurement-location: MeasurementLocation can identify a physical or virtual position on an asset or segment; it can identify a collection source address and transducer orientation. MeasurementSource is a collector or monitoring system. The three roles can differ.
source_findings.model-variant: ModelVariant uses parent and child models to represent a hierarchy of configurable variants. ModelRevision is a separate schema type. AssetModelEvent records past associations; current Model is a direct Asset link.
source_findings.work: WorkOrder collects requests and steps. Request, calendared work, active work and completed work are distinct representations. CompletedWork identifies actual work and can record used or removed resources.
source_findings.causality: ActualEvent may be substantiated by Measurement, optionally with ByAgent. ProposedEvent and HypotheticalEvent separately represent an explanatory hypothesis and a possible failure mode represented in an engineering study.
source_findings.reliability: RemainingLifeAssessment carries Estimate, Error and Confidence. LifecycleStatusHistory identifies the entity, required status type and optional status start date.

S06-R001.label: Manufacturer name
S06-R001.reason: Asset optionally identifies the manufacturer. Manufacturer inherits identifying names through its organization hierarchy.

S06-R002.label: Product model designation
S06-R002.reason: The optional Model association distinguishes equipment product designation from the serialized instance.

S06-R003.label: Individual hardware serial number
S06-R003.reason: SerialNumber is optional on a tangible instantiated Asset.

S06-R004.label: Persistent System identifier
S06-R004.reason: Entity UUID identifies an exchanged entity. The asset identity and identifiers from other authorities need separate corroboration.

S06-R005.label: Described sensing System / arrangement
S06-R005.reason: Physical asset composition and as-designed segment composition are distinct. Placement and exposure of component data require separate relationships.

S06-R007.label: Physical constituent
S06-R007.reason: Physical asset composition and as-designed segment composition are distinct. Placement and exposure of component data require separate relationships.

S06-R009.label: Hosting platform / station context
S06-R009.reason: An asset can be associated with an as-designed functional location over time. A current mount, empty-slot flag and RFC-style matching rule are additional claims.

S06-R010.label: Observing procedure / method
S06-R010.reason: A reusable algorithm can describe a processing procedure, and a measurement can identify its calculation type. These fields do not establish one complete acquisition protocol or prove which algorithm ran.

ISA-A-MEMBER-EXPOSURE.label: Composition member exposure and source attribution
ISA-A-MEMBER-EXPOSURE.reason: Physical asset composition and as-designed segment composition are distinct. Placement and exposure of component data require separate relationships.

S06-R011.label: Addressed transducer channel
S06-R011.reason: The ordered measurement-location entry can carry a channel number. Its location can carry a source address. These are separate from the transducer identity and from any network stream address.

S06-R013.label: Observed / observable property
S06-R013.reason: The category of a measurement point can identify what is measured and the associated quantity. Its value class describes the representation. The model does not require a decomposition into constituent entities and properties.

S06-R014.label: Observer / observing System
S06-R014.reason: A measurement can identify the collector or monitoring system, the transducer, and the asset concerned independently. Which participant performed a particular observation remains a case claim.

S06-R015.label: Performed Observation
S06-R015.reason: A concrete measurement record can carry its acquisition interval, recording time, point and data. The class declaration by itself provides no evidence of an actual equipment reading.

ISA-C-140.label: Human-readable observation comment
ISA-C-140.locator: XSD/CCOM.xsd · Measurement and Event → Nameable.Description; XSD/CoreComponentType_2p0.xsd · TextType
ISA-C-140.reason: Measurement and Event explicitly admit repeatable descriptive text through the Nameable group. An observation comment can occupy that role, while a dedicated comment category or author is unspecified.

ISA-C-132.label: Inferred past observation statements
ISA-C-132.reason: Diagnostics or prognostics may identify explanatory events and hypotheses. A prediction of an observation, quantified sensor performance or identity confidence requires different evidence.

ISA-C-143.label: Forecast observation statements
ISA-C-143.reason: Diagnostics or prognostics may identify explanatory events and hypotheses. A prediction of an observation, quantified sensor performance or identity confidence requires different evidence.

ISA-T-EVENT-ID.label: Source-qualified event identity and reference
ISA-T-EVENT-ID.reason: An event can retain its UUID, a source-local identifier and the information source. Event links identify cause and effect. These do not prescribe a key made from the creating component and event time.

ISA-T-EVENT-TIME.label: Event occurrence time
ISA-T-EVENT-TIME.reason: Event identity and temporal subject derive from the entity and timestamped-event structure. Start or end can denote an endpoint or a point event.

SAPIENT-F2-PERFORMANCE.label: Candidate — Declared detection performance and geometric error
SAPIENT-F2-PERFORMANCE.reason: Measurement confidence qualifies an individual measurement, hypothesis likelihood qualifies an event, and a threshold bounds a trigger. None establishes declared detector performance or geometric error.

ISA-K-PROPERTY-DECL.label: Declared property definition
ISA-K-PROPERTY-DECL.reason: The definition can declare a typed property with requiredness, defaults, enumerated alternatives or a structured value. Status publication rules require a separate source.

ISA-K-OBSERVABLE-DECL.label: Declared observable definition
ISA-K-OBSERVABLE-DECL.reason: A location can declare the kind and representation of a measurement before collection. Presence in a particular event and a message-level observable contract are separate questions.

SAPIENT-F2-ALERT-LIFECYCLE.label: Candidate — Alert identity, condition, status and acknowledgment lifecycle
SAPIENT-F2-ALERT-LIFECYCLE.reason: A triggered region identifies the condition and its type and may carry acknowledgment time and agent. Its lifecycle is distinct from the SAPIENT alert-message and acknowledgment exchange.

ISA-T-STATUS.label: Component property-value report
ISA-T-STATUS.reason: A named asset property can carry a typed value or reference a definition, individually or in a property set. This supports reporting property values without prescribing the Status message.

CASE-H02.label: REVIEW HOLD — site / mounting
CASE-H02.reason: No case-specific instance evidence was verified. The schema can represent lifecycle information without demonstrating this case.

ISA-C-075.label: Maintenance point of contact
ISA-C-075.reason: A maintenance work record can link the responsible agent role to the asset. Assignment to a particular job does not establish an enduring maintenance contact or supply contact details.

ISA-C-077.label: Manufacturer point of contact
ISA-C-077.reason: The manufacturer is an organization and can be associated with another agent through a role. Identifying a particular manufacturer contact and communication address requires additional records.

ISA-C-084.label: Component owner contact information
ISA-C-084.locator: XSD/CCOM.xsd · AgentRoleWithAsset.Asset/AgentRole; AgentRole.Agent/Type; AssetOwnerEvent; CCOM Reference Data.xml · AgentRoleType 5aeb0701-e130-4b81-a083-d7ffbb04bb54
ISA-C-084.reason: The reference catalog explicitly identifies the Owner role. A named agent in that role can be associated with an asset. Ownership-transfer parties, contact channels and the current owner are distinct claims.

ISA-C-092.label: Component program-of-record contact information
ISA-C-092.reason: Typed asset roles can identify a responsible agent. A program-of-record role and its contact information were not established in the reviewed role vocabulary.

ISA-C-110.label: Non-maintenance support contact information
ISA-C-110.reason: A typed role can associate an agent with an asset. The reviewed role vocabulary does not specifically designate a non-maintenance support contact or its address.

ISA-R-COMPONENT-CONTACT.label: Nominated component/contact identity record
ISA-R-COMPONENT-CONTACT.reason: An identified asset can be joined to multiple agent roles. The CCOM associations do not prescribe the nominated contact-list payload or communication fields.

ISA-C-099.label: Reported physical parent/child attachment relationships
ISA-C-099.reason: The serialized asset-component relation explicitly records parent and child assets in a breakdown. It does not independently establish live attachment status or relative position.

ISA-C-082.label: Reported component operating condition
ISA-C-082.reason: Asset health can be assessed qualitatively or on a scale, and operational changes can be logged as actual events. The component-reported state vocabulary and update obligations require separate evidence.

AAS-O2-RECORD-ADMIN.label: Candidate — Digital-record administration and business revision
AAS-O2-RECORD-ADMIN.reason: CCOM distinguishes creation and editing agents and timestamps for an identifiable record. These fields do not supply a business version or revision number.

AAS-O2-TEMPLATE-PROVENANCE.label: Candidate — Template that guided creation of a digital record
AAS-O2-TEMPLATE-PROVENANCE.reason: A property set can reference the definition used as its prototype or structural conformance target. The reference alone leaves the purpose and outcome of a particular use open.

AAS-O2-DATA-SPEC.label: Candidate — Applied supplementary data-specification templates
AAS-O2-DATA-SPEC.reason: A set definition can include other definitions, and an entity can receive multiple property sets. Supplementary AAS data-specification identities and serialization rules remain distinct.

AAS-O2-ELEMENT-LABEL.label: Candidate — Multilingual display label and description of an information element
AAS-O2-ELEMENT-LABEL.locator: XSD/CCOM.xsd · Nameable.FullName, Description; XSD/CoreComponentType_2p0.xsd TextType.languageID, languageLocaleID
AAS-O2-ELEMENT-LABEL.reason: FullName and Description may each repeat. Each text value can have its own language and locale, independently of the identifier.

AAS-O2-SUPPORTING-CONTENT.label: Candidate — Supporting file locator or embedded file content
AAS-O2-SUPPORTING-CONTENT.locator: XSD/CCOM.xsd · Document.FileName, Content; InfoSource.URL; DocumentForAsset; BinaryObject
AAS-O2-SUPPORTING-CONTENT.reason: An asset can reference an identified document with a filename, inherited source URL or binary content. The content and pointer carry different meanings.

AAS-O3-QUALIFIED-CONTEXT.label: Candidate — Value, concept and template qualification
AAS-O3-QUALIFIED-CONTEXT.reason: A property can identify its definition and state whether its value is valid within it. This does not assign qualifier kinds to a value, semantic concept or template.

AAS-O6-UNIT-CONTEXT.label: Candidate — Unit definition and quantity context
AAS-O6-UNIT-CONTEXT.reason: CCOM associates a unit with its quantity kind and reference unit. It specifies scale and offset for conversion, while independent unit-dictionary requirements remain separate.

AAS-O6-PRODUCT-CLASS.label: Candidate — Product classification and classification-system context
AAS-O6-PRODUCT-CLASS.locator: XSD/CCOM.xsd · Model.Type, Manufacturer; Asset.Type; TypeConnection.Network, From, To; Taxonomy
AAS-O6-PRODUCT-CLASS.reason: An asset and a manufacturer's model may have an asset type. Type connections can place types in a named taxonomy. This supports product classification within the recorded scheme.

AAS-O6-CAPABILITY-CONDITION.label: Candidate — Capability property conditions and applicability
AAS-O6-CAPABILITY-CONDITION.reason: Suitability of an asset type at a functional location and a property definition do not specify when properties constrain the exercise of a capability.

AAS-O6-CAPABILITY-DEPENDENCY.label: Candidate — Capability dependencies and temporal applicability
AAS-O6-CAPABILITY-DEPENDENCY.reason: Ordering work requests or steps does not express a dependency between two capabilities before, during or after exercise.

SOSA-SO2B-HEALTH-ASSESSMENT.label: Candidate — Reported health assessment and associated faults
SOSA-SO2B-HEALTH-ASSESSMENT.locator: XSD/CCOM.xsd · Asset.HealthAssessment; HealthAssessment.HealthLevelType, Confidence, SubstantiatingEvent; Event.Type
SOSA-SO2B-HEALTH-ASSESSMENT.reason: An asset's health assessment may record a level, confidence and substantiating timed events. The supporting events can be typed. They do not establish every source-specific reported fault flag.

SOSA-SO2D-SLOT-IDENTIFIER.label: Candidate — Container-scoped physical slot identifier
SOSA-SO2D-SLOT-IDENTIFIER.reason: A functional location can have a plant-local tag and belong to a segment hierarchy before installation of a serialized asset. A tag scoped to a specific card container is a narrower rule.

SOSA-SO2E-TASK-RECORD.label: Candidate — Identified task, lifecycle and task priority
SOSA-SO2E-TASK-RECORD.reason: Maintenance work and steps carry identities and can specify priority and status. The meaning and scope of a software task's lifecycle remain distinct.

SOSA-SO2E-CALIBRATION-STATUS.label: Candidate — Calibration activity state and latest reported result
SOSA-SO2E-CALIBRATION-STATUS.reason: A transducer can report its last calibration timestamp. The timestamp does not report whether calibration is underway or whether it succeeded.

SOSA-SO2I-POWER-CYCLE-RECOVERY.label: Candidate — Declared recovery behavior after a power cycle
SOSA-SO2I-POWER-CYCLE-RECOVERY.reason: A dated status or logged reboot describes history. It does not declare equipment's required recovery behavior or the need for physical intervention.

SOSA-SO2J-FAULT-SUGGESTED-ACTION.label: Candidate — Fault associated suggested corrective action
SOSA-SO2J-FAULT-SUGGESTED-ACTION.reason: The model associates an event with a specific recommendation. Its interpretation as a corrective response depends on the event and recommendation types. Completion is recorded separately.

OPCDI-ASSET-TAG.label: Candidate — User-assigned asset identifier
OPCDI-ASSET-TAG.locator: XSD/CCOM.xsd · Asset (ShortName annotation), SerialNumber; Entity.UUID; Nameable.ShortName
OPCDI-ASSET-TAG.reason: The asset definition designates ShortName as the plant user's identification tag. The same asset can independently carry a manufacturer serial number and an immutable UUID. The schema specifies no retagging workflow.

OPCDI-FUNCTIONAL-GROUP.label: Candidate — Purpose-based information group and shared membership
OPCDI-FUNCTIONAL-GROUP.locator: XSD/CCOM.xsd · PropertySet.Type, Group; PropertyGroup.Group, SetProperty; OrderedList.Type
OPCDI-FUNCTIONAL-GROUP.reason: Property sets and nested property groups organize data-sheet values. State-dependent visibility and the rules for sharing the same operation across groups remain separate.

OPCDI-SOLUTION-ASSIGNMENT.label: Candidate — Solution subpackage deployment targets and installation order
OPCDI-SOLUTION-ASSIGNMENT.locator: XSD/CCOM.xsd · SolutionPackageHierarchy.Order; SolutionPackageStep.SegmentType, AssetType, Asset, Order
OPCDI-SOLUTION-ASSIGNMENT.reason: A predefined work package can contain ordered, equipment-targeted steps. This is evidence for work planning. A software subpackage, its deployment path and installer behavior require separate evidence.

OPCDI-CONFIGURABLE-COMPOSITION.label: Candidate — Allowed component types versus configured composition
OPCDI-CONFIGURABLE-COMPOSITION.locator: XSD/CCOM.xsd · AssetTypeForSegmentType.AssetType, SegmentType, AssetTypeTaxonomy; AssetSegmentEvent.Asset, Segment
OPCDI-CONFIGURABLE-COMPOSITION.reason: A functional-location type can constrain suitable asset types. A separate installation event identifies a serialized asset and location. These mechanisms do not define a runtime interface for creating logical objects.

OPCDI-LIFETIME.label: Candidate — Lifetime consumption or remaining capacity and warning levels
OPCDI-LIFETIME.reason: Remaining service life is an assessment with optional estimate, error and confidence. Physical consumption and warning thresholds require separate evidence.

PADIM-CALIBRATION-RECORD.label: Candidate — Signal calibration timestamp and purpose
PADIM-CALIBRATION-RECORD.reason: The transducer can carry its latest calibration timestamp and be linked to its measurement point or reading. No calibration-purpose classification accompanies LastCalibrated.

PADIM-CALIBRATION-CHARACTERISTICS.label: Candidate — Technique-specific calibration characteristics and conditions
PADIM-CALIBRATION-CHARACTERISTICS.reason: Last calibration time and the raw-output conversion are independent transducer fields. The reviewed elements do not identify technique-specific coefficients or conditions measured at calibration.

PADIM-DICTIONARY-SEMANTICS.label: Candidate — Dictionary-qualified property meaning and enumerated values
PADIM-DICTIONARY-SEMANTICS.locator: XSD/CCOM.xsd · Property.Type; PropertyType.Enumeration; EnumerationItem; Entity.InfoSource, IDInInfoSource
PADIM-DICTIONARY-SEMANTICS.reason: A property references an identified type which can define enumerated choices. Entity identifiers and information sources provide context. Dictionary version and PA-DIM's required instance reference remain separate.

PADIM-SIGNAL-POINT-ID.label: Candidate — Measurement or control point identifier
PADIM-SIGNAL-POINT-ID.locator: XSD/CCOM.xsd · MeasurementLocation (ShortName annotation), MeasurementSourceAddress, Asset, Segment
PADIM-SIGNAL-POINT-ID.reason: The measurement-point definition explicitly assigns its ShortName as a local user identification tag. Its asset, segment and source address are separate optional fields. Virtual input/output ports are within the definition.

SAREF-DEVICE-KIND.label: Individual equipment and its device kind
SAREF-DEVICE-KIND.locator: XSD/CCOM.xsd · Asset.Type, Model, Function; Model.Type, Function; AssetModelEvent
SAREF-DEVICE-KIND.reason: An individual asset can refer to its type or model, and functions may be described at the model or asset level. The exchange does not automatically assert an inheritance rule for every capability.

OSUSR-SPATIAL-AUTHORITY.label: Authority for recorded asset or sensor position and orientation
OSUSR-SPATIAL-AUTHORITY.reason: Coordinates and orientation can be supplied with source records. These fields do not assign authority between a core and a plug-in for applying or overriding the position.

OSUSR-ACTIVE-LIFECYCLE.label: Managed asset activation transitions and failure state
OSUSR-ACTIVE-LIFECYCLE.reason: Asset lifecycle and readiness can be recorded with dates. The acquisition plug-in's explicit activating, active, failing and deactivating transitions are a separate state model.

RF-MANAGER-ENDPOINTS.label: Management responsibility versus physical controller location
RF-MANAGER-ENDPOINTS.reason: Responsibility for an asset and the functional location occupied by an asset can be recorded separately. The role holder is an agent and is not necessarily a physical controller with a chassis.

RF-CHASSIS-ZONE.label: Physical enclosure versus logical chassis zone
RF-CHASSIS-ZONE.reason: The source distinguishes a tangible asset from a designed functional unit or group. It does not declare a chassis-kind discriminator for physical packaging versus logical zones.

RF-SERVICEABILITY.label: Independent replacement and removal while operating
RF-SERVICEABILITY.locator: XSD/CCOM.xsd · AssetSegmentEvent; Reference Data/CCOM Reference Data.xml · WorkTaskType=Removal of Asset on Segment
RF-SERVICEABILITY.reason: A recorded or planned removal does not establish the vendor's permission for independent replacement or removal while power is on.

RF-ASSEMBLY-PEDIGREE.label: Assembly production, vendor and engineering change level
RF-ASSEMBLY-PEDIGREE.locator: XSD/CCOM.xsd · Asset.Manufacturer, Model; Reference Data/CCOM Reference Data.xml · AttributeType=Manufacturing Date
RF-ASSEMBLY-PEDIGREE.reason: The asset can identify its manufacturer and carry a manufacturing date. Supplier/vendor and engineering change level on the individual assembly are separate claims.

RF-SENSOR-SUBJECT.label: Sensor resource, source of an excerpt and equipment the reading describes
RF-SENSOR-SUBJECT.locator: XSD/CCOM.xsd · Measurement.MeasurementSource, Transducer, Asset, Segment, MeasurementLocation
RF-SENSOR-SUBJECT.reason: A measurement can separately identify the collector, transducer, measurement point and asset or segment. These support attribution, while an excerpt copied from a sensor resource needs its own provenance.

RF-LIMITS.label: Sensor measurement range, equipment operating limits and environmental derating
RF-LIMITS.locator: XSD/CCOM.xsd · Region.Minimum, Maximum; Reference Data/CCOM Reference Data.xml · AttributeType=Temperature, Rated Ambient Maximum, Temperature, Rated Ambient Minimum
RF-LIMITS.reason: The source can represent a measurement region and rated ambient temperature limits for equipment. Region bounds are not necessarily the physical sensor's measurement range, and no automatic derating rule was established.

RF-EXTREMA.label: Recorded minima, peaks and their timestamps
RF-EXTREMA.locator: XSD/CCOM.xsd · Measurement.CalculationType, Start, End, Recorded; Reference Data/CCOM Reference Data.xml · CalculationType=Maximum, Minimum
RF-EXTREMA.reason: Maximum and minimum are named calculation types on timed measurements. The acquisition interval and recording time do not necessarily pinpoint the instant at which an extreme occurred or the reset that began the interval.

RF-REPORT-HISTORY.label: Metric report replacement, append limit, wrap and suppression of repeated values
RF-REPORT-HISTORY.reason: Acquisition interval and duration concern measurement. They do not determine whether a report replaces or appends, wraps at a limit, or suppresses unchanged values.

RF-TIME-ACCURACY.label: Accuracy of a metric timestamp separately from value accuracy and precision
RF-TIME-ACCURACY.reason: Start and recording times are timestamps. Confidence concerns measurement accuracy. The reviewed declarations do not separately quantify timestamp uncertainty or significant digits.

RF-METRIC-SAMPLE.label: Metric sample linked to its resource property and metric definition
RF-METRIC-SAMPLE.locator: XSD/CCOM.xsd · Measurement.MeasurementLocation, CalculationType; MeasurementLocation.Type, Asset, UOMQuantity
RF-METRIC-SAMPLE.reason: A measurement can refer to an identified point on an asset with a point type, quantity and calculation method. A management resource's specific property path and separate metric definition remain additional bindings.

RF-CHASSIS-ENVELOPE.label: Manufacturer-declared chassis dimensions and mass
RF-CHASSIS-ENVELOPE.locator: XSD/CCOM.xsd · Model.Manufacturer, PropertySetDefinitionForModel; Reference Data/CCOM Reference Data.xml · AttributeType=Size, Height, Size, Width, Size, Length, Mass, Rated Maximum
RF-CHASSIS-ENVELOPE.reason: Manufacturer-model data sheets can name dimensions and rated mass. The declared property, unit and equipment instance must establish whether the values describe an enclosure of the required kind.

RF-REPLACEMENT-PART.label: Replacement part number versus installed assembly part number
RF-REPLACEMENT-PART.reason: The installed asset's model can carry a manufacturer part number. Material records can identify other models; identifying one as the approved replacement requires a separate association.

RF-SENSOR-DIGITS.label: Significant digits versus percent and absolute accuracy of a reading
RF-SENSOR-DIGITS.reason: Measurement confidence and the quantity's unit do not specify significant digits, percentage accuracy or absolute accuracy in that unit.

RF-COLLECTION-FUNCTION.label: Metric aggregation function, time scope and collection duration
RF-COLLECTION-FUNCTION.locator: XSD/CCOM.xsd · Measurement.CalculationType, Start, End; MeasurementLocation.CollectionDuration; Reference Data/CCOM Reference Data.xml · CalculationType=Average, Maximum, Median, Minimum
RF-COLLECTION-FUNCTION.reason: A result can identify its calculation and acquisition interval, and the point can specify collection duration. A metric-report-specific aggregation scope still needs a binding.

RF-REMEDIATION-STEP.label: Ordered corrective step with identified target and retry policy
RF-REMEDIATION-STEP.locator: XSD/CCOM.xsd · WorkStep.Order, Asset; Work.PriorityLevelType; RecommendationWorkStep; SolutionPackageStep
RF-REMEDIATION-STEP.reason: A maintenance step can refer to its asset and recommendation and can carry priority and order. It has no explicit retry limit in the reviewed declarations.

RF-INVENTORY-OCCUPANCY.label: Known equipment location with an absent or unavailable occupant
RF-INVENTORY-OCCUPANCY.reason: An as-designed functional location exists independently of the asset installed there. A missing event does not prove that a location is empty, and the schema does not prescribe the inventory advertisement.

RF-LAST-RESET-EVENT.label: Last system reset time and reported cause
RF-LAST-RESET-EVENT.locator: XSD/CCOM.xsd · TimestampedEvent.Start, End; EventLink.CauseEvent, EffectEvent; Reference Data/CCOM Reference Data.xml · AttributeType=Startup Date, Most Recent
RF-LAST-RESET-EVENT.reason: The reference data include the latest startup date and events may have cause links. A startup is not necessarily a system reboot and no universal reset-reason field was established.

RFC8348-MATCH.label: Matching detected equipment to its intended configuration
RFC8348-MATCH.reason: Suitability and installation associate assets with locations. They do not specify an identity-matching algorithm for choosing a configured component on hardware detection.

RFC8348-REFRESH.label: Server acquisition time and refresh interval of a sensor value
RFC8348-REFRESH.reason: A measurement can record when it was stored or captured by the original source. Its point can state the update interval. The roles of a managing server and its special interpretation of zero require additional evidence.

RFC8348-STATE-TIME.label: Last component state change and initialization or insertion fallback
RFC8348-STATE-TIME.reason: For each lifecycle status entry the source can record its effective-from date. It does not prescribe one clock across five hardware state dimensions or a fallback tied to insertion.

RFC8348-INVENTORY.label: Operational component inventory change time and notification
RFC8348-INVENTORY.reason: Editing an entity or logging an installation does not supply a system-wide operational inventory change timestamp or an associated change notification.

N4242-LIVE.label: Elapsed acquisition duration and detector live duration
N4242-LIVE.reason: Timed measurements and configured collection duration support elapsed collection time. Sensitive detector live time excluding processing dead time is a separate quantity.

N4242-QC.label: Inspection time and reported calibration fitness for service
N4242-QC.locator: XSD/CCOM.xsd · Transducer.LastCalibrated; HealthAssessment; Reference Data/CCOM Reference Data.xml · WorkTaskType=Inspect; ReadinessType=Serviceable (Issuable without Qualification)
N4242-QC.reason: The source distinguishes transducer calibration time, inspection work and asset readiness. It does not bind them as the result of the particular radiation-instrument calibration-fitness inspection.

N4242-LINEAGE.label: Measurement grouping and links from derived results to raw readings
N4242-LINEAGE.locator: XSD/CCOM.xsd · MeasurementAssociation.Measurement, RelatedMeasurement; Test.TestGroup; TestGroupComponent; Measurement.CalculationType
N4242-LINEAGE.reason: CCOM can group test components and link related measurements. The source does not require a directed derived-to-raw reference between values of the same radiation measurement kind.

N4242-ALGORITHM.label: Analysis execution, algorithm settings and reported status
N4242-ALGORITHM.locator: XSD/CCOM.xsd · Algorithm.Creator, Template, ProcessingURI, PortIO; FFTMeasurement.FFTSetup; Measurement.Start, End, CalculationType
N4242-ALGORITHM.reason: An identified algorithm can have a creator and a processing description. Measurements can reference their processing setups and calculation types. These fields do not constitute a timed algorithm-execution record with its own outcome.

N4242-MEDIA.label: Acquisition context linking measured items and multimedia
N4242-MEDIA.locator: XSD/CCOM.xsd · Test.TestedMaterial, Sample; Sample.SampledMaterial; Document.Content, EntityContent; EntityContent.Entity
N4242-MEDIA.reason: Tests and samples can identify the measured material, and a document can carry binary content or refer to structured entities. The particular media capture device, view, timing and processing sequence need separate bindings.

RFC8348-ADMIN-OPER.label: Administrative permission to use a component and its observed operability
RFC8348-ADMIN-OPER.reason: Readiness and lifecycle values describe equipment condition. These declarations do not express an administrator's permission to admit new users independently of observed operability.

RFC8348-ALARM-SET.label: Concurrent local alarm severities and repair status
RFC8348-ALARM-SET.locator: XSD/CCOM.xsd · Asset.ActualEvent; MeasurementLocationTriggeredRegion.Acknowledged; ProposedEvent.SeverityLevelType; Reference Data/CCOM Reference Data.xml · WorkTaskType=Repair
RFC8348-ALARM-SET.reason: Related records can describe alarm events, acknowledgement, assessed severity and repair work. They do not declare an aggregate set of concurrent component-local flags.

RFC8348-MGMT-ALIAS.label: Nonvolatile management alias and authority for assigning it
RFC8348-MGMT-ALIAS.locator: XSD/CCOM.xsd · Asset (plant user tag in ShortName annotation); Entity.UUID
RFC8348-MGMT-ALIAS.reason: A plant-local tag and immutable entity identifier are distinct. Neither field defines a nonvolatile management alias or authorizes a manager to assign it.

RFC8348-ENTRY-SCOPE.label: Physical scope of an equipment inventory entry
RFC8348-ENTRY-SCOPE.reason: Physical asset composition and as-designed segment composition are distinct. Placement and exposure of component data require separate relationships.

N4242-ELEVATION-REFERENCE.label: Ellipsoid elevation, surface offset and their separate accuracy estimates
N4242-ELEVATION-REFERENCE.locator: XSD/CCOM.xsd · GPSLocation.Elevation, GPSElevationType, GPSDatumType, GPSPrecisionType; Reference Data/CCOM Reference Data.xml · GPSElevationType=NAVD88, NGVD29
N4242-ELEVATION-REFERENCE.reason: Elevation can carry a datum, an elevation type and positioning-precision category. The reviewed source does not pair an ellipsoid height with a local-surface offset and separate numerical accuracies.

N4242-FAULT-OUTPUT.label: Reported fault impact on operation and trust in its output
N4242-FAULT-OUTPUT.locator: XSD/CCOM.xsd · Event.FunctionAffectedByEvent; HealthAssessment.SubstantiatingEvent; Measurement.DataQualityType; Reference Data/CCOM Reference Data.xml · DataQualityType=Inspected and Rejected, Quality Bad
N4242-FAULT-OUTPUT.reason: An event may identify the affected function, and a reading can report rejected data quality. The source does not derive data trust or operational impact from its radiation-fault severity.

IADOPT-SET-SCOPE.label: Applicable concepts for a set of observable variables
IADOPT-SET-SCOPE.reason: Grouping properties or ordered items does not declare the roles of concepts applicable to a set of observable variables.

IADOPT-CONSTRAINT-TARGET.label: What a constraint qualifies in an observable variable
IADOPT-CONSTRAINT-TARGET.reason: An association between measurements or a property template does not identify whether a variable constraint qualifies its entity, property or statistical modifier.

JOINT-SAMPLE-RECORD-TIMES.label: Measurement acquisition time and record creation time
